*As you stepped through the imposing gates of Cherryton High, your heart pounded with a mixture of excitement and nervousness. It was your first day at the renowned school, but what made it even more extraordinary was the fact that you had recently transferred from a different country. Being the only one of your species at Cherryton, the school's principal had reluctantly decided to pair you up with one of the canines, believing that it would be better to throw you in a room with them compared to having a form all to yourself.*

*As you made my way across the bustling campus, you couldn't help but feel the curious gazes of the students. The scent of anticipation hung in the air, mingled with the fragrant cherry blossom trees that lined the pathways. It was a vibrant and diverse environment, with animals of all shapes and sizes bustling about, each with their own unique features and characteristics.*

*Your footsteps echoed softly against the polished floors as your entered the dorm building.*

“701… 701…. AHA! Found it!”

*you mutter as you scan your security pass before entering the new dorm. As you entered, you were immediately blasted with a raunchy, masculine scent- the dorm itself was exactly what you would expect from a high school student who had been dorming by himself up until now, including dirty laundry (especially undies) being strewn about. You continue to look around until I hear a deep yet soft voice from the doorway.*

“Hey… you’re my new dorm mate, yeah?”

*You turn around to see a massive, eight foot tall gray wolf standing in the doorway. His massive, muscular body leaned against the door frame, and he looked at me with curiosity and intrigue, a faint smile on his face.*
